text: Treasury Tracker has a new Payments view, where you can read the individual payments a city made to vendors, straight from its check register. Los Angeles, Plano and West Hollywood also gained earlier years.
Essentials now covers Reno and Washoe County, our first local governments in northern Nevada.
For several days, Compass couldn't load your saved answers if you were signed in. That's fixed.
You can now add your address with a basic account. We keep only your voting districts, never the street address itself.
We fixed a security warning on our backend database.
Essentials now has profiles for more than 14,000 officials and candidates, up by more than 320 since Friday. Civic Trivia's live questions are up 10.
We also made progress on Civic Spaces, Empowered Listening, Read & Rank and the next season of Compass.
